title: TUI State Management
description: How the TUI model handles different application states using Bubble Tea.

steps.title: App States
steps.description: The application has states for selecting files, entering paths, loading, viewing walkthroughs, and confirming delete.

steps.title: Model Structure
steps.description: The Model holds all TUI state including the list, navigator, walker, styles, and highlighting configuration.

steps.title: Update Function
steps.description: The Update function handles tea.KeyMsg for keyboard input and switches on AppState for state-specific behavior.
